verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's integrations pages list connectors that sync data in automatically: Meilisync for MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, a Firebase collection sync, Rails ActiveRecord auto-sync, and a first-party Laravel Scout driver. That covers database and ORM ingestion without a custom pipeline, but there is no evidence of an official web or content crawler, and it is unclear whether Meilisync and the Firebase sync are first-party. One hands-on report says the Rails gem fell out of step with the server, and another says index setup and document upload took almost a week of coding. Missing for 10: an official web/content crawler, explicit first-party status and depth docs for Meilisync and Firebase sync, independent hands-on corroboration that the connectors work reliably.

support.subject: As a founder, I can ingest content with an official crawler or connectors instead of writing my own indexing pipeline
